The rooms

Two rooms, both bookable by the half day.

Stage A takes builds, cars and crews. Studio B is the common area for lunch hours, equipment drops and general lounging. Book either on its own, or both when the day needs a second setup running.

How a booking runs

Four steps, in this order, every time.

Nothing here is a surprise on shoot day. Holds are free and soft until the deposit lands, and the cage is prepped the night before your call.

01 — Hold

Put the date down

Tell us the dates, the room and roughly what you are shooting. We hold it soft for five business days, no card.

02 — Quote

Quote and COI

A line-item quote comes back inside a day. Half down and a certificate of insurance naming Ace Studio confirms the hold.

03 — Check-out

Prep and walk-through

Gear is built, tested and carted the night before. You walk the cage with us at call and sign the sheet.

04 — Wrap

Wrap and check-in

Back on the cart, counted against the same sheet, balance invoiced that week. Media offloads here if you want it.
